head: 2a38044

smoke.notes: Offline, no API keys (MothVault degrades to labeled mock), <1s wall. Checks: engine reflex self-write, bus pool in (0,1) + zero-trust zero-influence, hedge leader emergence, spreader graft-override + prune, resonance lock r>0.99, gardener modulation, vault stream ~U(0,1) (mean 0.493, sd 0.289), receipt chain seal/verify, provenance relay-verified/echo-convicted/source-clean/influence-discounted/conviction-unsticks.

essence: Gossip trust economy: envelope + log-odds pooling, Hedge trust, provenance/admission gates, evolutionary gardener — every claim receipted

ideas.name: murmur envelope + trust-weighted log-odds pooling
ideas.statement: Ambient gossip is a convention carried by cell values: {topic, from, p, n, ttl}; the bus pools log-odds weighted by sender-trust x evidence-mass, so a confident liar with low trust is outvoted by a hesitant truth-teller with high trust, and quarantine (zero influence) falls out for free at w=0.

ideas.name: trust as online learning, not hand-tuned scores
ideas.statement: Trust edges are Hedge multiplicative weights with fixed-share (Herbster-Warmuth): regret-bounded under regime flips, with entropy/leader readouts as the mesh's opinions, and echo convictions written back through absorb so penalties persist and re-earn through the normal update path.

ideas.name: the protocol layer is the gate layer (v3/v3.1)
ideas.statement: Outcome-trust cannot see echoes; the protocol must. Provenance tags (relay/echo/dup/clean) re-price influence, edge-precedence + mirror guard attribute direction, fractional per-murmur attribution reacts instantly, and cold-start admission (age + independent edges + usefulness + aggregate capShare) plus the founder-velocity guard close the attack windows E17/E19/E21/E24/E27/E33/E35 left open.

ideas.name: the evolutionary mesh: gardener, spreader, tree, resonance
ideas.statement: Thought is a copied cell family with a mutated seed; prune and graft are edits to thought; a meta-bandit gardener reads three scalars (order parameter r, trust entropy H, regret delta) and writes three scalars (temperature, prune floor, spawn budget) under a hard credit budget; subtree operators and structure-aware Kuramoto coupling open headroom node metrics lack.

ideas.name: substrate + evidence discipline
ideas.statement: Everything stands on three tiny substrates (the envelope, the fnv1a64 witness chain, the harvest-once entropy vault) and every claim carries a receipt: sheet pooling verified against reference math in-run (480/480, 200/200), full reruns bit-exact, honest nulls (resonance is not an accuracy meter) receipted like wins.

parts.name: murmur envelope {topic, from, p, n, ttl}
parts.essence: The irreducible gossip atom: what is whispered, by whom, at what belief p, with what evidence mass n, living ttl rounds; provenance v3 adds optional origin (null = I made this).
outputs: live murmur row (snapshotted into the provenance log)
parts.gate: p and n must be finite numbers
parts.failure_mode: pre-fix: NaN p/n poisoned the WHOLE topic (posterior NaN or silent 0.5); now loud throws at the boundary

parts.name: fnv1a64 witness chain (seal/verify)
parts.essence: The fleet canon receipt idiom ported verbatim: append-only hash chain, sealChain stamps row_hash = hash(prev, row-minus-hash), verifyChain re-derives and fails with at/why.
parts.gate: every row must carry row_hash matching re-derivation from genesis
parts.failure_mode: any byte edited anywhere in the chain breaks verification at that seq (hash mismatch)

parts.name: entropy vault: harvest once, stretch honestly
parts.essence: MOTH_KEY env-only; one quantum harvest fills a bit pool; streamFor derives per-seed sub-streams by two-stage cross-key counter mode (E17 receipted avalanche fix); without a key it degrades to a deterministic LABELED mock — a mock never pretends to be quantum.
parts.gate: liveJobs hard cap maxLiveJobs; offline/budget refusal yields labeled mock, never silent
parts.failure_mode: pre-fix naive counter stream returned near-constant draws (0.595442, 0.595441...) silently degenerating downstream tests

parts.name: trust-weighted log-odds pooling (logarithmic opinion pool)
parts.essence: pulse() ages murmurs, groups per topic, computes L = sum w_i*n_i*logit(p_i), posterior = sigmoid(L/W) with p clamped to [0.02,0.98]; also emits voices, agreement (1 - dispersion), dominant, trustMean. Static MurmurBus.pool mirrors the sheet formulas for verification.
outputs: Map topic -> {posterior, voices, agreement, dominant, trustMean}
parts.gate: W > 0 else posterior = 0.5; influence mass W is the pool's conservation denominator
parts.failure_mode: empty-topic or all-zero-trust topic would silently read 0.5 (documented default, not hidden)

parts.name: Hedge fixed-share trust update
parts.essence: w_i <- ((1-alpha)w_i + alpha/N) * exp(eta*r_i), softmax-stabilized, normalized; fixed-share forgets regime flips so a factor that turns bad loses its crown; per-step weight snapshots recorded.
parts.gate: weights always renormalized to sum 1 (mass conserved); rewards clamped to [0,1]
parts.failure_mode: without fixed-share, trust saturates and a turned factor keeps its crown forever (header comment)

parts.name: zero-trust quarantine for free
parts.essence: weight(id) returns 0 for unknown senders; a zero-weight murmur contributes 0*logit = 0 to L and 0 to W — nexus's quarantine needs no code, it falls out of the pool.

parts.name: entropy + leader readouts
parts.essence: Normalized Shannon entropy of the weight vector (low = the mesh has opinions) and leader() = argmax weight with margin — the scalars the gardener and experiments consume.

parts.name: novelty-edge extraction (value + jump evidence)
parts.essence: A |dv| > edgeTheta crossing records {t, v, prev, jump} — a copier reproduces the same jump to the same value; honest eyes sharing a regime do NOT share error timings. Only novelty has direction (E19 finding #0).
outputs: per-sender edge lists (pruned to attribution window)
parts.failure_mode: raw content matching brands the SOURCE an echo of its own plagiarist (autocorrelation is direction-symmetric) — the receipted reason edges carry value+jump

parts.name: relay-first verification (declared origin)
parts.essence: If a murmur declares an origin and its content matches that origin's history at some lag with rate >= confirm, it is a RELAY — checked before any plagiarism scan: a verified claim beats content suspicion; relaying is legal range extension.
parts.gate: matchRate(origin, L) >= 0.8 for some L in 1..maxLag, and origin != self
parts.failure_mode: declaring a FALSE origin fails content verification (only verifies against the declared origin's own history)

parts.name: echo conviction by edge-precedence rate + mirror guard
parts.essence: j echoes k iff >= minEdges of j's edges value+jump-align to k's at consistent lag L, alignment RATE >= 0.8 over the window, content corroborates at (k,L), and k does not echo j at any lag at least as strongly (mirror guard); copy-of-copy re-attributes to the root of the chain.
parts.gate: aligned >= minEdges AND rate >= confirmEdges(0.8) AND rate > reverse-best AND content >= confirm(0.8)
parts.failure_mode: edge COUNT convicts innocents (dense error trains + equal levels, E19 finding #1); without the mirror guard the COPY SOURCE gets crushed (E21 receipted a1MFrac 0.021)

parts.name: dup detection (honest redundancy)
parts.essence: Flat content (sd <= dupSigma) that also matches someone's past is DUP: two equal eyes colliding at p~0.5 get influence x0.5 and NO trust penalty — the asymmetry prefers dup over echo when evidence is ambiguous because false-dup harm is bounded.
parts.gate: sd <= dupSigma(0.02) AND matchRate(id2, L) >= confirm for some peer/lag
parts.failure_mode: false dup costs only the correlation itself (pooled votes barely move when merged)

parts.name: influence re-attribution (tags -> weights)
parts.essence: Raw trust becomes pool influence per tag: echo x0.15, dup x0.5, relay = epsRelay x trust(origin), clean = own. The sheet's pool formulas never change — provenance only changes what weights ARRIVE at the w.* cells.
parts.failure_mode: sheet inference math stays pure by construction (v3 doctrine one layer deeper); verified byte-identical 480/480

parts.name: state-level echo penalty with floor (absorb path)
parts.essence: Confirmed plagiarists' trust is multiplied by (1-0.15)/round while convicted, floored at 0.02, renormalized, and written back into the learner via absorb so the penalty persists across rounds and re-earns through the normal Hedge path; tags unstick when copying stops (72/72 reformed).
parts.gate: penalized weight floored at floor=0.02 — never zeroed (reform must remain possible)
parts.failure_mode: permanent branding would make a reformed plagiarist unrecoverable; tags are re-reviewed every round

parts.name: fractional per-murmur attribution (v3.1)
parts.essence: Continuous echo-score s_j (EWMA of corroborated alignment rate, mirror-guarded) times a value-novelty term: m = (1-s_j)*(alpha + (1-alpha)*n_j); influence = w*min(m, tagCap). The novelty term reacts in round one of copying; the echo-score needs ~2 novelty events — complementary in time. Receipted limit: correctness is RELATIVE (copiers sink below honest voices), never absolute.
parts.gate: infl = w * min(m, tagCap) — hard tag caps the extreme, soft score does the fine grading
parts.failure_mode: value-novelty is direction-blind: the copied SOURCE also loses novelty while copies exist; direction lives in s_j only (admission.mjs header)

parts.name: cold-start admission gate
parts.essence: Joiners are PROBATIONARY (influence x epsNew=0.15) until age >= admitWindow(40) AND >= minEdgesIndep(2) independent novelty edges (independence fixed at edge-creation time: a later matcher would be the copier, not the source) AND mean |p - pooled| <= admitErr(0.5) during probation.
parts.gate: age >= 40 AND indepEdges >= 2 AND devMean <= 0.5, else influence stays x epsNew
parts.failure_mode: a pure-noise joiner passes independence (edges echo nobody) — the HedgeTrust outcome learner demotes it; admission gates IDENTITY economics, not competence; E35 showed a patient sleeper can walk through probation honestly and flip after admission

parts.name: aggregate probationary influence cap (sybil flood-breaker)
parts.essence: Total probationary influence mass per round is capped at capShare=0.10 of the round total via closed-form fixed-point redistribution; no number of fresh copies can buy more than capShare of the vote no matter how their trust was bootstrapped.
parts.gate: P <= capShare*Z enforced exactly (post-cap share = capShare), then uniform renormalize back to Z
parts.failure_mode: capShare is PROBATION-ONLY economics: E33 receipted 48 sybils legitimately ADMITTED (copying an uncorroborated founder reads as independent), after which the cap no longer applies and share hits 0.136

parts.name: founder acclamation (D1 genesis rule)
parts.essence: Senders present at the FIRST observe() round are admitted at round 1, never probationary: admission prices UNKNOWN mid-stream joiners; the genesis crowd is constitutive. Receipted grounds: honest relays would strand forever (their edges are echoes of their origin by design) and taxing the first ~100 rounds buys no anti-sybil gain.
parts.gate: present at round 1 AND coldStart -> admitted by acclamation
parts.failure_mode: sybils present AT genesis are trust's problem (E17/E19 territory), not admission's — boundary honestly drawn

parts.name: hard-tag backstop caps
parts.essence: The per-sender hard tags remain CAPS on the extremes while the fractional layer does fine grading: echo caps at epsEcho 0.15, dup at 0.5, clean at 1; verified relays keep pure provenance semantics and are NEVER judged by the independence bar (a relay's evidence is by construction echoed).
parts.gate: min(m, tagCap) — soft layer can only lower, hard tag bounds the worst case
parts.failure_mode: per-SENDER hard tags are coarse: everything a convicted sender says is x epsEcho until it reforms

parts.name: whisper boundary fail-safes (gauntlet fixes)
parts.essence: Non-finite p/n throw at the envelope boundary; the provenance log stores a SNAPSHOT of each envelope because pulse() decays ttl in place on shared references (receipted: log silently aged with the live queue).
parts.gate: Number.isFinite(p) && Number.isFinite(n) else throw
parts.failure_mode: pre-fix: one bad voice silently destroyed every other voice's evidence (NaN L) and the provenance log aged with live state

parts.name: gardener meta-bandit under a hard credit budget
parts.essence: epsilon-greedy over bold/steady/timid policies; each reads vitals (r, H, regretDr, alive) and writes temperature, prune floor, spawn decision, graft aggression; spawning spends credits (refill 0.5/round, cap 8), each policy has a distinct credit floor (bold>=1, steady>=2, timid>=3) and alive < maxBranches.
parts.gate: spawn only if alive < maxBranches AND credits >= policy floor AND world-signal condition
parts.failure_mode: pre-fix floors (>0/1/2) let fractional refills drive credits NEGATIVE (receipted: bold at 0.5 spawned to -0.9) — the hard budget leaked

parts.name: spreader: branch / prune / graft
parts.essence: branch = copy base factor estimates with Irwin-Hall jitter from the branch's own vault stream (grafted ids override jitter — the fruit moves intact); prune = kill worst-ranked branches whose last-place streak exceeds floorStreak, at most maxDead per generation; graftPlan transplants the factors the mesh trusts most (trust guides the knife).
parts.gate: prune: streak >= floorStreak, ranked worst, capped at maxDead (2) per generation
parts.failure_mode: graft cycles silently corrupt topology (handled at tree level, P22); unbounded prune would erase diversity

parts.name: tree operators: subtree graft with cycle rejection, pure candidate views
parts.essence: E23's lift: scoreTree T = wq*discounted leaf quality + wc*canopyResonance + wd*lineageDiversity - ws*mean(depth^2)/budget evaluated on CLONED views (no mutation); graftSubtree re-roots a subtree shifting depths, pruneSubtree kills node+descent and eases siblings' failing streaks; illegal re-roots throw, candidate views return null.
parts.gate: graft target must NOT be inside the moving subtree (cycle) — throw in graftSubtree, null in graftView; accept iff T rises
parts.failure_mode: pre-fix re-rooting into one's own subtree hung rootPath()/lineageDiversity() FOREVER (receipted child-process repro)

parts.name: Kuramoto resonance (agreement as physics)
parts.essence: Each branch is an oscillator (phase = opinion, omega = drift); coupling = endorsement agreement; order parameter r = |mean(e^{i-theta})| is the scalar a meta-cell reads. Receipted honesty: r is a lie detector (Delta = -0.141, 19/20 seeds), NOT an accuracy meter (corr ~ 0, null receipted).
parts.gate: r must EARN its keep: corr(r_t, future regret) receipted each run; gating trust on r HURTS (E22 corollary)
parts.failure_mode: a mesh can be coherently wrong — reading r-levels instead of r-drops mistakes consensus for truth

parts.name: founder-velocity guard (v3.2 candidate, experiment-local)
parts.essence: Watches each ENTRENCHED voice's reward trajectory: longRun = EWMA_0.01, recent = EWMA_0.08; trip on gap > 0.15 for 8 rounds PLUS a wrong-side band test (recent reward < 0.45, between toxic 0.375 and honest >= 0.5 asymptotes); while tripped, absorb a per-round x0.85 multiplier. First lever acting on WHAT a voice says, not where it came from. E31: trips 8/8 seeds (median 25 rounds post-turn), ZERO false trips, reaches 0.25x demotion 88.5 rounds faster.
parts.gate: EWMA gap > delta(0.15) for k(8) rounds AND recent < recentCeil(0.45), only for entrenched voices; untrip at gap < 0.10
parts.failure_mode: protocol layers are founder-blind to self-authored values (E27: the 0.25x bar NEVER reached within 250 post-turn rounds without the guard); guard was receipted against a HARDER generator than E27's mislabeled one (E31 generator receipt)

parts.name: the sheet pattern (repo-as-sheet, seasonal loop)
parts.essence: env.* sensors -> ex{i}.b{X} endorsement cells -> br{X}.* branches -> t.f* trust cells -> mesh.scar listener reflex -> gardener -> receipts.jsonl; the seasonal loop sense -> infer -> elect -> pay -> learn; reflexes write their own memory (engine.get on a program re-executes it — receipted engine lesson).
outputs: a runnable mesh sheet (smoke sheet: 6 cells, ~140 cells in E14)
parts.gate: dotted-prefix law, listener caller.metadata contract, CellValue unwrap, multi-char ids — four receipted engine lessons are load-bearing conventions
parts.failure_mode: bare `current` in listener conditions is silently undefined; 1-char ids corrupt candidate ids after formula compilation

parts.name: smoke gate (CI-first one-pass verification)
parts.essence: 16 checks across engine, bus, trust, spreader, resonance, gardener, vault statistics, receipts, and the full provenance lifecycle (relay verified, echo convicted, source clean, influence discounted, conviction unsticks) — runs first, exits nonzero on any fail.
parts.gate: fails === 0 else exit(1)
parts.failure_mode: any primitive regression blocks CI before experiments can manufacture numbers

parts.name: experiment receipt summaries (verdict history)
parts.essence: Every E-experiment lands a *_summary.json + receipts_*.jsonl in experiments/outputs: E17 gossip trust + echo vulnerability, E21 admission (sybShareSpin 0.069 -> 0.010, verify 200/200), E31 guard, E33 flood, E35 sleeper, E37 trust lane — the verdict ledger this decomposition reads.
inputs: paired-arm experiment runs (identical worlds, same seeds)
parts.failure_mode: E21 receipted a metric bug: a denominator error MANUFACTURED a copy-source conviction (0.0208 = 0.25/13) that forensics dissolved — summaries record their own corrections

parts.name: in-run equivalence verifications
parts.essence: The sheet's pooled cells are checked against reference math at sampled rounds every run: E14 pool✗=0, E16 maxDiff 0 over 4000 rounds, E17 4800/4800 at 1e-9, E19 480/480 across arms, E21 verify 200/200; full reruns bit-exact 4/4 — the pool digest is the reproducible universe handle.
parts.gate: sheet pooling must equal reference math byte-for-byte or the run is invalid
parts.failure_mode: a Math.random-fed vault diverges at round 0 (E34) — determinism is productivity itself

cells.expr: world observation cell (set by the seasonal loop)
factor-1 endorsement of branch 3 (copied with mutated seed by spreader)
HedgeTrust weight of sender ex1 (written back each season)
sigmoid( sum(infl_i * n_i * logit(p_i)) / sum(infl_i * n_i) )
provenance.inspect(): relay if declared-origin verified | echo if edge-rate>=0.8 & mirror-guard | dup if flat&redundant | clean
Kuramoto order parameter over alive branches' phases
policy(r, H, regretDr, alive, credits) -> {temp, pruneFloor, spawn, graftAggr}
on pool flip: runtime.set('scar.memory', ...) — reflexes write their own memory
append-only fnv1a64 witness chain; row_hash = hash(prev, row)

layer_logic.0: Substrate = three tiny durable representations: the murmur envelope (gossip atom), the fnv1a64 witness chain (tamper-evident event log), and the harvest-once entropy pool (labeled mock when keyless). Nothing above them needs a network; the protocol is a convention over cell values.
layer_logic.1: Mechanisms transform belief: trust-weighted log-odds pooling merges voices; Hedge+fixed-share moves trust on rewards; edge extraction gives novelty direction; tags and fractional scores re-price influence; spreader/tree operators copy, kill, and transplant thought; Kuramoto turns agreement into a scalar.
layer_logic.2: Policy decides who speaks with what weight: relay-before-suspicion, echo/dup conviction bars with mirror guard, cold-start admission (age + independence + usefulness), the 10% probationary flood cap, founder acclamation, hard-tag backstop caps, gardener credit budgets, and the founder-velocity guard — every one a concrete pass/fail condition the JEV sweep can walk.
layer_logic.3: Interface = the sheet cell grammar (env/ex/br/t.f/mesh.scar cells, loadSheet, two-segment ids) and the smoke harness; the mesh touches the outside only through cells and receipts — no sockets, no keys in code.
layer_logic.4: Evidence = receipts.jsonl chains everywhere, per-experiment summary JSONs as verdict history, in-run sheet-vs-reference equivalence checks (480/480, 200/200), bit-exact full reruns keyed by the pool digest, and receipted honest negatives (r is not an accuracy meter; provenance is dead weight vs good-voice-copying cliques; capShare is probation-only).
